name: Jean Amrouche
role: Algerian francophone writer, poet and journalist

checks.lead: Jean el Mouhoub Amrouche (Kabyle: Jean-lmuhub Ɛemruc; 7 February 1906 in Ighil Ali, French Algeria – 16 April 1962 in Paris, France) was an Algerian francophone writer, poet and journalist.
